name: Greater Tuberosity Fracture of Humerus
definition: Fracture of the greater tuberosity of the proximal humerus, often occurring with shoulder dislocation and affecting rotator cuff attachment.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are first-line; CT/MRI is selected for displacement or associated cuff injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Sling and early guided ROM for suitable stable fractures
amber: Displaced fragments may require fixation to restore cuff mechanics.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-bhagna/Snayu phenotype may be documented after imaging.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the greater tuberosity of the proximal humerus, often occurring with shoulder dislocation and affecting rotator cuff attachment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
